proposed_widenings.name: grant_movement_through_openings
proposed_widenings.justification: Gaseous Form grants a persistent movement capability that is not reducible to speed, teleportation, or forced movement.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target can move through a space as small as 1 inch wide without squeezing

proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.restrict_action_set
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface only carries action restriction nested under grant_extra_action, but Gaseous Form imposes an ongoing prohibition rather than granting an extra action with exclusions.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target can't attack or cast spells.

proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.target_ends_effect_as_bonus_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The potion adds a voluntary early-end rider that consumes action economy; existing duration end triggers are passive events only.
proposed_widenings.evidence: until you end the effect as a Bonus Action

notes: The unit fits magic_item + activation structurally, but I did not author content because the inherited Gaseous Form effect would require omitting core mechanics. No trace was generated.
